Error Handling 8. Code Examples Getting Started Base URL API Version Current version: v1.2 (Released: March 2024) The Nightingale API uses semantic versioning. Breaking changes will result in a new major version (v2, v3, etc.). We maintain backward compatibility for at least 12 months after introducing breaking changes. Content Type All requests and responses use JSON format. Technology StackProduction: https://api.nightingale.health/v1 Sandbox: https://sandbox-api.nightingale.health/v1 Content-Type: application/json Accept: application/json API Gateway: Kong Gateway (v3.2) running on AWS API Gateway Backend Services: Go (Golang 1.21) microservices Request Processing: Average latency: 45ms (p50), 120ms (p99) Powered by: Goroutines for concurrent request handling Service mesh: Istio for inter-service communication Database Layer: PostgreSQL 15 for relational data MongoDB 6.0 for flexible document storage Redis 7.0 for caching and session management Message Queue: Apache Kafka for asynchronous event processing Authentication API Key Authentication All API requests require authentication using an API key passed in the Authorization header. Obtaining an API Key: 1. Log into the Nightingale dashboard 2. Navigate to Settings → API Keys 3. Click "Generate New

processing Authentication API Key Authentication All API requests require authentication using an API key passed in the Authorization header. Obtaining an API Key: 1. Log into the Nightingale dashboard 2. Navigate to Settings → API Keys 3. Click "Generate New Key" 4. Store securely - keys cannot be retrieved after creation API Key Format: Prefix indicates environment: nk_live_ (production) or nk_test_ (sandbox) 32-character alphanumeric identifier JWT Tokens (OAuth 2.0)http Authorization : Bearer YOUR_API_KEY_HERE nk_live_a7f3k9m2p8q4r6s1t5u0v7w9x2y4z6 For user-specific actions, use JWT tokens obtained via OAuth 2.0 flow. Token Endpoint: Response: Token Expiration: Access tokens expire after 1 hour. Use refresh tokens to obtain new access tokens without re-authentication. Security Note: Tokens are signed using RSA-256. Never expose client secrets in client-side code. Core Concepts Resources User: A healthcare provider (doctor, nurse, technician) with a Nightingale account Channel: A conversation space (1-on-1 DM, group chat, or department channel) Message: A communication sent within a channel Alert: A critical notification with escalation policy Presence: Real-time status of a user (online, offline, busy, away) Object IDshttp POST /v1/auth/token Content-Type : application/json { "grant_type" :"password" , "username" :"doctor@hospital.com" , "password" :"secure_password" , "client_id" :"your_client_id" , "client_secret" :"your_client_secret" } json { "access_token" :"eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..." , "token_type" :"Bearer", "expires_in"

Real-time status of a user (online, offline, busy, away) Object IDshttp POST /v1/auth/token Content-Type : application/json { "grant_type" :"password" , "username" :"doctor@hospital.com" , "password" :"secure_password" , "client_id" :"your_client_id" , "client_secret" :"your_client_secret" } json { "access_token" :"eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..." , "token_type" :"Bearer", "expires_in" :3600, "refresh_token" :"rt_a7f3k9m2p8q4r6s1t5u0v7w9x2y4z6" , "scope":"messages:write messages:read users:read" } All objects have unique IDs following this format: IDs are prefixed to indicate object type and use base58 encoding. Pagination Endpoints returning lists support cursor-based pagination for optimal performance. Request: Response: Parameters: limit: Number of results per page (default: 50, max: 100) cursor: Pagination cursor from previous response API Endpoints Messages Send a Messageusr_a7f3k9m2p8q4r6s1 (User ID) chn_t5u0v7w9x2y4z6b8 (Channel ID) msg_c4d6e8f0g2h4i6j8 (Message ID) alt_k0l2m4n6o8p0q2r4 (Alert ID) http GET /v1/messages?channel_id=chn_abc123&limit=50&cursor=cur_xyz789 json { "data":[/* array of messages */ ], "pagination" :{ "next_cursor" :"cur_def456" , "has_more" :true, "total_count" :1247 } } Send a new message to a channel.
